files: 数据文件在 uploads/ 目录：orders.csv（订单，GBK 编码）、master.xlsx（customers / products 两个 sheet，customers 表头前有一行标题）、crm_contacts.csv（CRM 客户行业）、targets_2025.csv（各大区 2025 年销售目标）。销售额 = 数量 × 单价；“已支付”指 状态 = 'paid'。 另有：口径说明.md（公司业务口径）、targets_2026.csv（2026 年各大区目标）、returns_log.csv（退货登记）。

tasks.q: 各大区已支付订单的销售额是多少？按销售额从高到低列出。
tasks.gold: SELECT c.大区, round(sum(o.数量*p.单价),2) v FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.状态='paid' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

tasks.q: 退款订单一共有多少笔？
tasks.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE 状态='refund'

tasks.q: 哪个品类的已支付销售额最高？销售额是多少？
tasks.gold: SELECT p.品类, round(sum(o.数量*p.单价),2) FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.状态='paid' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.q: 2025 年哪个月的订单数最多？有多少单？
tasks.gold: SELECT strftime(下单日期,'%-m') || '月', count(*) FROM orders WHERE year(下单日期)=2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.q: 华东区客户平均每笔订单买几件（订单数量的平均值，保留两位小数）？
tasks.gold: SELECT round(avg(o.数量),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE c.大区='华东区'

tasks.q: 下单次数最多的前 3 个客户是谁？各下了多少单？
tasks.gold: SELECT c.客户名称, count(*) n FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 3

tasks.q: 各大区的退款率（退款订单数 / 总订单数）分别是多少？哪个最高？
tasks.gold: SELECT c.大区, avg(CASE WHEN o.状态='refund' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.q: 有多少客户从来没有下过单？
tasks.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id)

tasks.q: 2026 年 1–8 月的已支付销售额，比 2025 年 1–8 月增长了百分之多少？
tasks.gold: WITH s AS (SELECT year(o.下单日期) y, sum(o.数量*p.单价) v FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.状态='paid' AND month(o.下单日期)<=8 GROUP BY 1) SELECT (SELECT v FROM s WHERE y=2026)/(SELECT v FROM s WHERE y=2025)-1

tasks.q: A 等级客户贡献的已支付销售额占全部已支付销售额的比例是多少？
tasks.gold: SELECT sum(CASE WHEN c.等级='A' THEN o.数量*p.单价 END)/sum(o.数量*p.单价) FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.状态='paid'

tasks.q: 结合 CRM 表里的行业，哪个行业的已支付销售额最高？是多少？
tasks.gold: SELECT r.行业, round(sum(o.数量*p.单价),2) FROM orders o JOIN crm r ON CAST(substr(r.客户编码,3) AS INT)=o.customer_id JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.状态='paid' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.q: 各大区 2025 年已支付销售额完成了目标的百分之多少？哪个大区完成率最高？
tasks.gold: SELECT c.大区, sum(o.数量*p.单价)/max(t."2025年目标") r FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) JOIN targets t ON t.大区=c.大区 WHERE o.状态='paid' AND year(o.下单日期)=2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.q: 已支付订单的平均订单金额（客单价）是多少？
tasks.gold: SELECT round(avg(o.数量*p.单价),2) FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.状态='paid'

tasks.q: 建一张派生表 paid_orders，只保留已支付订单，并加一列 金额（数量×单价）。告诉我这张表有多少行、金额合计多少。
tasks.gold: SELECT count(*), round(sum(o.数量*p.单价),2) FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.状态='paid'

tasks.q: 把各大区的已支付销售额汇总导出成 CSV 文件。
tasks.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT 大区) FROM customers

tasks.q: 做一个销售看板：总销售额 KPI、各大区销售额柱状图、按月销售趋势，只统计已支付订单。
tasks.gold: SELECT 1

tasks.q: 按公司口径，2025 年各大区的 GMV 分别是多少？哪个大区最高？
tasks.gold: SELECT c.大区, round(sum(o.数量*p.单价),2) FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.状态='paid' AND c.等级<>'C' AND year(o.下单日期)=2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.q: 2025 年有多少活跃客户？
tasks.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE 状态='paid' AND year(下单日期)=2025 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>=20)

tasks.q: 各大区 2026 年 1–8 月已支付销售额分别完成了 2026 年全年目标的百分之多少？完成率最高的是哪个大区？
tasks.gold: SELECT c.大区, sum(o.数量*p.单价)/(max(t."目标(万元)")*10000) r FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) JOIN targets26 t ON t.大区=c.大区 WHERE o.状态='paid' AND year(o.下单日期)=2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

tasks.q: 退货登记表里一共涉及多少个不同的订单？这些订单里有多少笔在订单表中的状态并不是 refund？
tasks.gold: WITH r AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(substr(订单号,3) AS BIGINT) oid FROM returns) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM r), (SELECT count(*) FROM r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.oid WHERE o.状态<>'refund')
